mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) above 2.5% YoY signals inflationary pressures that typically lead to tighter monetary policy, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If CPIAUCSL YoY > 2.5% and S&P 500 forward 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A sudden increase in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.5% in one month signals a weakening labor market, which historically correlates with negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If UNRATE increases > 0.5% in 1 month and S&P 500 forward 5-day returns are positive in more than 50% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in real GDP (GDPC1) for two consecutive quarters signals a weakening economy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If GDPC1 declines for 2 consecutive quarters and S&P 500 forward 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in industrial production (INDPRO) by more than 1% in a month signals strengthening supply-side fundamentals, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If INDPRO increases > 1% in 1 month and S&P 500 forward 20-day returns are negative in more than 40% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate (UNRATE) is below 4% and nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) increase by more than 200,000 in a month, it signals a tight labor market and strong economic growth, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If UNRATE < 4% and PAYEMS increases > 200,000 and S&P 500 forward 20-day returns are negative in more than 50% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) signals an accommodative monetary policy, which typically leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If FEDFUNDS decreases and S&P 500 forward 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in housing starts (HOUST) by more than 10% in a month signals weakening demand in the housing sector, which is a leading indicator of broader economic weakness, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If HOUST declines > 10% in 1 month and S&P 500 forward 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: When real GDP (GDPC1) growth is positive but retail and food services sales (RSAFS) decline for two consecutive months, it signals a decoupling of consumer spending from economic growth, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 positive growth and RSAFS declines for 2 months
failure_condition: If GDPC1 shows positive growth and RSAFS declines for 2 months and S&P 500 forward 20-day returns are positive in more than 50% of triggered instances.
